arguments.body: Hi Luca, this is written notice that HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) will visit 19 Victoria Park Road on Tuesday 13 October between 9am and 1pm for the annual gas safety check. It takes about an hour and someone aged 18+ needs to be home. The current certificate runs out on 16 October, so we need to do it this week; doing it now keeps the same yearly anniversary date. You'll get a copy of the record within 28 days of the check. If the time doesn't suit, just reply or call us with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange. We'll also write to you by letter.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026: the CP12 issued 17 Oct 2025 (compliance.json, system record, Gas Safe 550123 matching HeatRight) is valid. The legacy note 'renewed 2025, all good' is an old-agency hint and is not trusted over the system record; it fits the same cert. Compliance lapses after 16 Oct if no new check is done.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Previous attempts (email 25 Sep, email+SMS 2 Oct) went unanswered. Now booked HeatRight for 13 Oct (3 days' notice, over 24h), sent written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange, and set a 12 Oct follow-up. No entry without tenant agreement; if still no response, escalate for further options.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Expiry date 16 Oct, tenant unresponsive, visit booked 13 Oct with HeatRight, notice sent on all channels, early renewal keeps anniversary, tenant gets copy within 28 days, cost approval up to his £300 limit requested by 12 Oct, and that we cannot force entry.

The legacy note 'renewed 2025, all good' is an old-agency hint and is not trusted over the system record; it fits the same cert. Compliance lapses after 16 Oct if no new check is done.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Previous attempts (email 25 Sep, email+SMS 2 Oct) went unanswered. Now booked HeatRight for 13 Oct (3 days' notice, over 24h), sent written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange, and set a 12 Oct follow-up. No entry without tenant agreement; if still no response, escalate for further options.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Expiry date 16 Oct, tenant unresponsive, visit booked 13 Oct with HeatRight, notice sent on all channels, early renewal keeps anniversary, tenant gets copy within 28 days, cost approval up to his £300 limit requested by 12 Oct, and that we cannot force entry.
